property_summary: After initialize is called with any _baseToken, the contract's baseToken() getter must return that _baseToken; the mutant incorrectly always sets it to address(0).
After initialization, the nft address stored in the contract must equal the _nft parameter passed to initialize; the mutant sets it to address(0) instead.
After calling initialize, the state variable changeFee must equal the passed _changeFee argument, not a hardcoded value; the bug sets it to 1 regardless of the argument.
After initialization, the changeFee state variable must equal the _changeFee argument passed to initialize, but the mutant leaves it at zero because the assignment is missing.
After initialization, the feeRate state variable must equal the _feeRate argument if it is <= 5000, but the buggy version always sets it to 5000 regardless of the argument.
After a successful initialize call, the feeRate getter should return the _feeRate argument passed to initialize; the mutant fails to set feeRate, so it returns the zero default instead.
After a successful call to initialize(...), the initialized flag must be true; the mutant omits setting it, so initialized remains false.
After a successful initialize call, the contract's initialized flag must be true, but the mutant sets it to false, allowing reinitialization.
After initialization, the payRoyalties state variable must equal the _payRoyalties argument passed to initialize, but the buggy version always sets it to false regardless of the input.
The variable payRoyalties must equal the _payRoyalties argument passed to initialize, but the mutant always sets it to true regardless of the argument.
After initialization, payRoyalties() must equal the _payRoyalties argument; the mutant always returns true regardless of the input.
After initialize() is called with any parameters, the stored payRoyalties value must equal the _payRoyalties argument, but the buggy version stores _useStolenNftOracle into payRoyalties instead.

After initialization, the public state variable payRoyalties of C must equal the boolean _payRoyalties argument passed to initialize; the mutant leaves it unset (defaulting to false) regardless of the argument.
After initialization, the value of useStolenNftOracle in the reference contract is exactly the input _useStolenNftOracle, while in the buggy version it is negated.

After initialization, the state variable virtualBaseTokenReserves in the reference contract equals the passed _virtualBaseTokenReserves, whereas the buggy contract sets it to _virtualBaseTokenReserves + 1, violating equality.
After initialization, virtualBaseTokenReserves must equal the value passed to initialize; the bug sets it to 0 regardless.
After initialization, virtualBaseTokenReserves must equal the value passed to initialize; the mutant leaves it as 0, violating this equality.
After initialization, the virtualNftReserves of the reference contract equals the input parameter, whereas the buggy contract leaves it at zero.
